productionStandard.masterFirstRule: The approved artwork master is the only visual source of truth. Convert that exact artwork into ordered path data; never design a substitute Live illustration.

artworks.title: A Rainy Tea Afternoon
artworks.moment: A quiet cup beside a rain-streaked window
artworks.palette: mostly black ink on warm ivory paper; rare vermilion accents

drawingSequence.notes: Strong confident structural strokes establish the setting and sill.
Flowing main branch first, then only a few selected leaves.
Long, elegant, restrained lines in the distance.
Only enough roof and building strokes to reveal it.
Careful, simple outlines; very few defining details; paper remains visible inside objects.
Red sun, maple leaves and tiny intended accents appear last.

artworks.replayRequirement: The encoded paths array in rainy-tea-afternoon-001.json must follow these six stages in order. The renderer reveals paths progressively in stored array order; it does not create named stage pauses.

artworks.title: A Clear Day at the Maple Pavilion
artworks.moment: A quiet autumn scene beneath a maple branch, with a pavilion, wind chime, distant mountains and an open red sun
artworks.palette: near-black brush ink, restrained soft-grey distance, textured vermilion tones on warm ivory paper

drawingSequence.notes: Reproduce the exact main trunk and connected maple branches from the approved master. Preserve the tapered brush silhouette and its dry-brush edges.
Draw the pavilion roof contours, central support and small railings in their exact positions and proportions. Keep the roof interior as warm paper.

drawingSequence.strokeWeight: medium to thin; restrained soft grey where present
drawingSequence.notes: Add both mountain ridges, the quiet horizon and water/cloud-line marks. Preserve the original open spacing.

drawingSequence.stage: The foreground garden and water edge
drawingSequence.notes: Draw the curved bank, stream marks, stones, grasses and small flowering twig. Keep each detail in its original location.
Reveal the hanging bell, paper charm and two distant birds. Preserve the open paper within the hanging charm.

drawingSequence.strokeWeight: selective red tones and paper highlights
drawingSequence.notes: Add the red sun, maple leaves, drifting leaves and tiny blossom/charm accents last. Retain the original red texture and fine light marks; do not simplify them into flat solid shapes.

artworks.replayRequirement: The paths array in clear-maple-pavilion-001.json is authored in the six stages above. Replay reveals records in their stored order. The existing renderer does not create named stage pauses.
